queue.freshness_scope: Last collection attempt, not a guarantee of a usable or executable market quote. Price and security timestamps must still pass their own gates.
queue.capacity_note: Due totals use the effective periodic schedule and retain paused background candidates. A new watch or evidenced story can shorten a previous daily schedule without rewriting it. Promised jobs bypass periodic polling; alerts and controls share protected capacity. Research watch slots are reserved before surplus followups. API capacity can still cause missed deadlines; missing outcomes remain unknown.
